subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public discovery-only manifest contract for macOS Computer Use providers?
rationale: The contract is useful and aligned with manifest-first plugin discovery, but it affects public plugin API shape and host permission semantics that automation cannot safely decide.

options.title: Review and land the metadata contract
options.body: Confirm the linked PR's field names, docs, tests, and security wording make the metadata discovery-only before merge.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until the macOS host binding flow defines exactly how provider metadata is consumed.

options.title: Reject or narrow the contract
options.body: Close or revise the direction if existing manifest metadata or a different plugin API should own the discovery path.

recommendation.title: Review and land the metadata contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the linked PR's field names, docs, tests, and security wording make the metadata discovery-only before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current manifest/registry surface and adjacent macOS provider-catalog work point to steipete as the best available owner for the boundary decision.
